text:
alex: Quick async check — kernel/queue handshake sprint update. TL;DR: blockers: infra mmap for persistent cache files + SRE rate-limit policy. Need ownership clarifications for canary rollout. Proposed milestone: code freeze Fri 03/27, canary Mon 03/30, full rollout Wed 04/01. Any objections?

sophia: I'm owning the batching kernel changes (PR #432). ETA EOD Thu for feature branch. Need infra to unblock the mmap mount for the persistent KV warmup; pinging @eng-infra.

jamal: I'll take the KV cache warmup heuristics PR review tomorrow AM. Question: are we locking the cache key schema before landing? I think we should to avoid incompatible warmup keys across model variants. Example snippet for the key prefix we discussed:```python
# warmup key format
key = f"kv:{model_name}:{version}:{prefix_hash}"
```

lina: SRE note — for the canary we want a soft rate-limit at 50rps per region with rapid fallback to cpu-priority=2 to avoid noisy neighbors. I'll open ENGOPS ticket and add the policy. @sre-oncall can you confirm quotas for the canary window?

chris: FYI I merged a small scheduling tweak (batching weight) into the branch—might change tail latency slightly. For the canary set `batch_window_ms: 6` to keep latency tight. Testing looked fine on smaller workloads but keep an eye on p99.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary-group/kernel-queue-v2 -> 1954322500 (started).

jamal: saw the deploy event. Added kernel_queue.drain_time p99 to the metric set; abort rule: drain_time p99 > 300ms. If anyone wants the dump script for KV stats during canary:```bash
# run on node
/sbin/rd-kv-dump --prefix kv:my-model --limit 1000 > /tmp/kv_snapshot.json
```
Also pinging reviewers: please review PR #432 @sophia @chris — small API change around WarmupController.

sophia: ack, will review tonight. Found a minor test nit in `scheduler_test` — adding review comment. @alex if you can do a quick rollout sign-off after CI passes that'd be great.

alex: Ownership clarified — batching kernel -> sophia, KV heuristics/metrics -> jamal, canary ops -> lina. Dependencies: eng-infra for mmap and mount config, eng-sre for ephemeral quota bump. If infra doesn't unblock by Thu noon we shift the canary one week.

lina: I'll create ENGOPS-1123 and tag eng-infra. Adding the SLOs to the ticket and the rollback criteria (kern_queue.drain_time p99 > 300ms OR error-rate > 0.5%).

sre-oncall: We have capacity for the canary window; created support ticket to raise ephemeral limits for the region. I'll monitor and post updates in this thread during deploy.

chris: Quick QA: add a smoke check in the deploy job to curl /health and /metrics every 10s for the canary group. I'll patch the deploy job and drop the snippet in CI.

alex: Perfect. Keep async updates here (short notes only). If anything crosses the abort thresholds ping for a 15m call. :thumbsup:
